content:
Apple recently launched the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Duo, but three more new iPhone models will reportedly arrive in early 2027. Here’s what’s coming.

#1: iPhone 18

iPhone 18 was conspicuously absent from Apple’s annual September event this year. Instead, the company launched iPhone 18 Pro and kept iPhone 17 around as the base model.

But the iPhone 18 is still coming, expected to launch in early 2027—likely February or March.

The basic design of the iPhone 18 is expected to stay unchanged as Apple prioritizes internal upgrades. Rumored new features include a more powerful A20 chip with at least a slight RAM bump, plus increased battery life.

We’re not expecting iPhone 18 Pro’s camera upgrades, smaller Dynamic Island, or vapor chamber to come to the base model. One question mark is the C2 cellular modem. iPhone 17 uses a Qualcomm modem, and it’s unclear whether that will be the case with iPhone 18 as well.

#2: iPhone 18e

Apple also has a lower-cost iPhone 18e model reportedly in the works. It’s expected to launch around the same time as iPhone 18.

Reporting indicates the iPhone 18 and 18e might be more similar than prior corresponding models. Improvements coming to the 18e include:

  • A20 chip
  • larger battery
  • larger 6.3-inch display
  • possibly a Dynamic Island and/or an improved front camera

ProMotion is expected to be missing from the new model, which will still have a 60Hz display. And while big rear camera upgrades are unlikely, a recent CAD leak suggests iPhone 18e might get a larger camera bump.

#3: iPhone Air 2

The iPhone Air 2 will reportedly aim to address two of the top wishes users had for the first-gen model. Those two upgrades are:

  • Adding an Ultra Wide camera
  • Improving battery life

By adding a second rear camera, iPhone Air 2 will at least offer camera parity with the base iPhone—something the original Air couldn’t with its single camera.

Battery life gains could ease concerns about the iPhone Air 2 running a full day on a charge. And hopefully the Air 2 will benefit from positive word-of-mouth about the first model.

Another tentpole addition is the A20 Pro chip, which might include one less GPU core than iPhone 18 Pro but otherwise be very similar.

Following the introduction of these three iPhone models in early 2027, Apple is expected to launch new Pro and Duo models in fall 2027.

Are you interested in buying any of these upcoming iPhone models? Let us know in the comments.
